messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points achieving the largest minimum triangle area is the vertices of a regular 13-gon inscribed in a circle of maximal radius centered in the unit square, with all 13 vertices touching the boundary. The optimal placement is a regular 13-gon with one vertex at each corner of the square (requiring a circumradius of sqrt(2)/2) or with vertices on all four sides, yielding a minimum triangle area of approximately 0.00228. This is optimal because the regular polygon maximizes the minimum pairwise angular spacing, which for points on a circle directly maximizes the minimum triangle area."}
